answers: I took on the project.
I was put in charge of the project.
questions.explanation: be put in charge of = ~을 담당하게 되다

answers: We came up with a new plan.
We figured out a new plan.

questions.korean: 그 행사는 나쁜 날씨 때문에 취소됐어.
answers: The event was called off due to bad weather.
The event was canceled because of bad weather.
She dealt with the situation well.
She handled the situation well.
He got through the financial difficulties.
He overcame the financial challenges.
I wish I were taller.
I wish I was taller.
questions.hint: I wish + 주어 + were (현재 사실의 반대 소원)
questions.explanation: wish 뒤엔 were가 격식체, was도 허용됨

answers: I wish I had studied harder.
If only I had studied more.
questions.hint: I wish + had + p.p. (과거 사실의 반대 소원)
questions.explanation: If only = I wish보다 강한 후회 표현

answers: I wish he were here.
If only he were here.

questions.korean: 그때 그걸 사지 않았으면 좋았을 텐데.
answers: I wish I hadn't bought it.
I wish I hadn't gotten that.
I wish the weather were better.
If only the weather was nicer.
questions.hint: I wish + the weather + were + 비교급

topic: 도치 구문 (Inversion) - Not only / Neither / So

answers: Neither he nor I went there.
Neither of us went there.
questions.hint: Neither A nor B = A도 B도 ~않다

answers: She speaks not only English but also French.
Not only does she speak English, but she also speaks French.
questions.hint: not only A but also B

answers: So do I.
Me too.
questions.hint: So + 조동사 + 주어 = 나도 그래 (긍정 동조)
questions.explanation: Me too = 구어체, So do I = 격식체

answers: Neither have I.
Me neither.
questions.hint: Neither + have + 주어 = 나도 안 그래 (부정 동조)

answers: Not only that, he is also good at math.
On top of that, he's great at math.
The movie was really moving.
The film was truly touching.
I was disappointed with the result.
I felt let down by the outcome.
questions.explanation: disappointing = 실망스러운 것, disappointed = 실망한 사람

answers: The lecture was boring.
The class was so dull.
questions.hint: boring = 지루하게 만드는, bored = 지루함을 느끼는

answers: She was surprised by the news.
She was shocked by the news.
questions.explanation: surprising = 놀라게 하는, surprised = 놀란 사람

answers: That's a really interesting proposal.
That's a fascinating suggestion.
I studied while listening to music.
Listening to music, I studied.

questions.korean: 숙제를 마치고 나서, 그녀는 게임을 했어.
answers: Having finished her homework, she played games.
After finishing her homework, she played games.
questions.hint: Having + p.p. = 먼저 완료된 동작 표현

answers: Turning left, you'll see the bank.
If you turn left, you'll see the bank.

questions.korean: 그는 다리를 꼬고 바닥에 앉아 있었어.
answers: He was sitting on the floor with his legs crossed.
He sat on the floor, crossing his legs.
Frankly speaking, I don't agree.
To be honest, I disagree.

topic: 조건문 - unless / as long as / provided that

answers: Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
If you don't hurry, you'll be late.
I'll go as long as you allow me.
I'll go provided that you give permission.
questions.hint: as long as / provided that = ~하는 한
questions.explanation: as long as = 조건을 강조, provided that = 격식체

answers: You can't enter unless you have an ID.
Without an ID, you won't be allowed in.
questions.hint: unless + have ID = without an ID

answers: As long as you follow the rules, there's no problem.
You'll be fine as long as you stick to the rules.
questions.hint: as long as + follow the rules

questions.korean: 비가 오지 않는다면 소풍 갈 거야.
answers: We'll have a picnic unless it rains.
We'll go on a picnic as long as it doesn't rain.
questions.hint: unless it rains = if it doesn't rain

questions.korean: 그녀는 내가 생각한 것보다 훨씬 더 똑똑해.
answers: She is much smarter than I thought.
She's way smarter than I expected.
The situation is getting worse and worse.
Things are getting increasingly worse.

questions.korean: 네가 더 열심히 노력할수록 결과가 더 좋아질 거야.
answers: The harder you try, the better the results will be.
The more effort you put in, the better the outcome.
This is different from what I expected.
This isn't what I had in mind.
questions.explanation: have in mind = 마음속에 생각하고 있다

answers: He is completely different from his father.
He's nothing like his father.
I'll take care of it.
I'll handle it.
It's driving me crazy.
It's driving me nuts.
He was already in the know.
He already knew about it.
questions.hint: be in the know = 알고 있다 (내부 정보)

answers: That's hilarious.
That's so funny.
She handles pressure well.
She works well under pressure.
Do you know where he lives?
Do you have any idea where he lives?
questions.hint: Do you know + 의문사 + 주어 + 동사?

questions.korean: 그녀가 왜 화가 났는지 이해할 수 없어.
answers: I can't understand why she got angry.
I don't know why she got upset.
Do you know when the meeting starts?
Can you tell me when the meeting begins?
questions.hint: Do you know + when + 주어 + 동사?

questions.korean: 그가 무슨 말을 했는지 말해줄 수 있어?
answers: Can you tell me what he said?
Do you know what he told you?
questions.hint: Can you tell me + what + 주어 + 동사?

answers: I don't know how long the project will take.
I'm not sure how long it'll take to finish.
questions.hint: I don't know + how long + 주어 + will + 동사

answers: I do miss him.
I really do miss him.
He did try hard.
He did make an effort.
She does cook well.
She really does cook well.

questions.korean: 나는 강조하고 싶은 건, 이게 중요하다는 거야.
answers: What I want to emphasize is that this is important.
The point I want to make is that this matters.
questions.hint: What I want to say/emphasize is that ~

questions.korean: 바로 그 순간이 모든 게 바뀐 때야.
answers: That was the moment when everything changed.
It was at that exact moment that everything changed.
